status: Post-pilot diagnostic plan recorded before quarter-stratified fits; not preregistered
population: Human-authored initial PR episodes with defined prior 90-day integration HHI; fixed existing submission covariates and first-disposition outcomes
question: How much concentration variation is between creation quarters, and how sensitive are existing associations to nonlinear calendar adjustment and within-quarter baseline comparisons?

calendar_spline.selection: Fixed modest basis declared to parent before preview model outputs were inspected; no selection by significance, likelihood or effect direction

models: Exact existing primary linear-calendar Cox model
Primary Cox model replacing linear calendar with four spline columns
Primary Cox model stratified by creation quarter, removing calendar covariates and retaining prior role/experience covariates
Piecewise model replacing linear calendar with four spline columns
Piecewise model with baseline strata crossed by role/experience and creation quarter, removing calendar covariates
uncertainty: Existing quarter-clustered sandwich covariance and Student t critical value with G-1 degrees of freedom; few clusters and cross-quarter dependence remain limitations
failure_policy: Retain planned fits and their errors; reject rank-deficient, nonfinite, non-positive-information or nonconverged fits; do not change basis, strata or covariates to obtain an interval

preview_disclosure.description: Before recording this plan, exploratory natural-spline df 3/4/5 fits were calculated. Four df were declared before their outputs were inspected. All preview directions are disclosed; the quarter-stratified analyses were not yet executed.

limits: Within-quarter contrasts reduce between-quarter confounding but cannot control within-quarter confounding or evolving post-submission workload.
Quarter strata change the risk-set comparisons and hence the conditional association estimand; this is not a causal estimate or an independent replication.
At most 23 creation-quarter clusters are available, and 90-day exposure windows overlap across quarter boundaries.
The late piecewise association is based on selected surviving episodes and only 56 observed merges before any information exclusions.
A four-df spline cannot represent arbitrary workflow changes; no model establishes identification of a concentration effect.
